findings.summary: AssistantSection says the assistant reads each 'empresa ativa', but assistantSummaryService (server/services/assistantSummaryService.ts) omits active companies that have no completed, non-archived diagnosis. The copy is slightly over-broad; no data is exposed beyond the RULE-dm-17 fields.

`pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts` was not run: tests/e2e/ does not exist yet (checked). Those specs belong to 4-integration-e2e-features. Runtime evidence for the settings screen and its accessibility is deferred to integration.

messages.text: Once 4-integration-e2e-features creates tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts and tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts, run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts` from the project root with the app served by the Play (or `pnpm start`). Selectors: radiogroups aria-label 'Modo de uso' and 'Tema', select #settings-focus-company (owner mode only), data-aioson-id settings-assistant-fields, theme-toggle, mode-chip. The whole UI is gated on GET /api/preferences; if that route is not mounted, every screen shows 'Não foi possível abrir o FitPulse'. server/app.ts mounts createPreferenceRoutes at line 55 (checked).

Preferences contract checked against server/services/preferenceService.ts and server/validation/preferenceSchemas.ts: GET returns focusCompanyId null for an archived company; PUT is partial; focusCompanyId null clears it; tourSeen merges per key. src/api/preferencesApi.ts and PreferencesProvider.tsx match this shape.

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit && vite build exit 0; 0 'error TS' lines; 'built in 1.20s'. Full output saved in the run temp directory (build.log, ends with EXIT_CODE=0).
7/224 enforced rules over 6 files: 0 violations (code-size, coupling, source-code-language, status-change-confirmation).

Read all six unit files against the contract: preferencesApi partial PUT/GET types; PreferencesProvider loads before render, applies data-theme and color-scheme, restores the last saved value on a failed save and only the newest save writes its answer; main.tsx wraps App in PreferencesProvider; App.tsx routes and AppShell nav links (empresa/:companyId, configuracoes, inicio placeholder) resolve to existing components.

SettingsPage renders 'Como ler os resultados' (guidance, calculation version per diagnosis, RULES_VERSION for new ones, no change to old scores) and 'O que o assistente do Play pode ler' (health; name, stage, weakest dimension and last-diagnosis date for each active company; no money values or answers). Matches server/services/assistantSummaryService.ts fields and /api/health, with the low copy note above.
